description: attachLatestReviewStatus issues one separate reviews query per pull request inside a for loop instead of a single batched query — a classic N+1 pattern with the query call itself visible directly inside the loop body, not a hypothetical scale concern.

required_findings.justification: The `supabase.from("reviews")...eq("pull_request_id", pr.id)` call sits directly inside the `for (const pr of pullRequests)` loop body, issuing one round-trip per pull request instead of a single query batched with `.in("pull_request_id", ...)`. This is concrete, visible evidence of an N+1 access pattern in the diff itself — not a speculative claim about traffic or table size not shown here.

explanation: Deliberately gives CONCRETE evidence (the query call literally inside the loop) rather than asking the reviewer to assume scale/traffic it can't see — the batched fix would move `.in("pull_request_id", pullRequests.map(p => p.id))` outside the loop entirely, which is exactly what makes this a real, visible defect rather than a guess about production load.
